instruction: An hourglass with twin blown-glass bulbs joined at a slim waist, suspended in a clear crystal frame with faceted end caps. Fine golden sand streams through the pinch and catches light, while the transparent walls refract soft caustics around the base.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Glass Hourglass in a glass/crystal style. An hourglass with twin blown-glass bulbs joined at a slim waist, suspended in a clear crystal frame with faceted end caps. Fine golden sand streams through the pinch and catches light, while the transparent walls refract soft caustics around the base. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
